name: application-tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Anchored text hints revealed on hover or keyboard focus, for labeling icon-only controls or adding brief supporting context to a trigger.
useWhen: Labeling an icon-only button so sighted users get the same context screen readers get from aria-label.
Adding a short, one-line hint to a trigger without permanently taking up layout space.
Explaining a setting or field in a sentence or two via a title-and-description rich tooltip.
avoidWhen: The content is essential to complete a task — tooltips are hidden by default and unreliable on touch devices.
The content is long-form or contains interactive elements — use a popover or dialog instead.
The information must always be visible — use inline help text instead.
responsiveBehavior: Tooltips are hover/focus-only and have no dedicated touch affordance; on touch devices, pair the trigger with a visible label or use a popover instead where content must always be reachable.
accessibility: The tooltip carries role='tooltip' and is linked to its trigger via aria-describedby.
Icon-only triggers carry a real aria-label independent of the tooltip, so the accessible name does not depend on hover.
Visibility is driven by group-hover and group-focus-within, so keyboard users see the tooltip on Tab focus, not only on mouse hover.

variants.title: Simple hover
variants.description: Top-anchored tooltip with a short text label revealed on hover or focus.
accessibility: The trigger's aria-describedby points at the tooltip id so assistive tech announces the hint on focus.

variants.title: Simple hover (Dark)
variants.description: Top-anchored tooltip adapted for dark surfaces, using a light bubble for contrast.
accessibility: Tooltip text and background must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Icon button
variants.description: Bottom-anchored tooltip labeling an icon-only button, paired with a real aria-label on the trigger.
accessibility: The icon-only trigger has its own aria-label so its accessible name does not depend on the tooltip being visible.

variants.title: Icon button (Dark)
variants.description: Icon-button tooltip adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Trigger hover and focus states must remain visible against a dark background.

variants.title: Rich (title + description)
variants.description: Right-anchored tooltip with a bold title and a supporting sentence, for explaining a setting in more than a few words.
accessibility: Title and description are both included in the aria-describedby text read by assistive technology.

variants.title: Rich (title + description, Dark)
variants.description: Rich title-and-description tooltip adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Title and description contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark surfaces.
